title: Ravelry Project Update Yardage Used Leaderboard
dataSources: Ravelry projects (`ravelry:project`), knitCompanion row counters (`knitcompanion:counter`), Shelly smart-plug machine runtime (`shelly:status`), and Ravelry stash entries (`ravelry:stash`).
app: Ravelry project and stash exports, knitCompanion row-counter logs, and Shelly plug telemetry for sewing-machine hours sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ravelry:project yardage_used=*
| stats sum(yardage_used) as total_value, avg(yardage_used) as avg_value by project_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks project name values by total and average yardage used across Ravelry project update events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `yardage_used` values for each Ravelry project update event and review total and average yardage used by project name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total yardage used.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which project name shows the biggest yardage used numbers in your Ravelry project update data.
